evidence.description: The initializer obtains the investment rate directly from Statistics.shared to schedule the timer.
totalInvestedAt obtains Statistics.shared directly and uses its investment statistics to calculate the result.

candidates.explanation: InvestmentsProjection directly accesses the shared statistics dependency for its scheduling and investment-calculation behavior. The dependency is not supplied through an explicit, replaceable boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The static shared instance exposes a public mutable subscriptions array without actor isolation or synchronization.

candidates.explanation: The mutable subscriptions instance property is reachable through InvestmentsProjection.shared. No visible actor isolation or synchronization protects this state; scheduling the timer on the main queue does not isolate access to the public property.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
